notes.title: Nightmare Expansion: New Enemies, New Game Mode, and More!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279916/9fa4f8f64e9512bd2e3e77061d1e5307858bde68.png

Adventurers, after months of work, I am happy to announce the Nightmare Expansion for Claymores of the Lost Kingdom. Featuring a new game mode, new enemies, events, and more -- this expansion was originally planned to be paid DLC. However, after a hundred hours of testing I realized that it completes the whole experience in such a way that there's no going back. In other words, all of the Nightmare content will be available to everyone for free, today!

Features:
New 'Nightmare' game mode for the bravest and most talented of adventurers ('Legend' achievement required to unlock) with 10 levels of difficulty going from extremely challenging to impossible
More enemies
More events
More status effects
Minor balance changes to the base game mode
Loads of bugs and glitches fixed, and more!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279916/47b0f890093e0064236862cfe338cdcf1732468f.png

Thank you all for playing and giving the game hundreds of hours, it means a lot!

Kind regards,
the Dev

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed gang panel glitching into a battle.
 Fixed local rumors from sometimes giving an "error" message.
 Fixed Attunement Stone not working when playing a 0 mana card while at full hand.
 Various typos fixed.

notes.title: Adventure Begins!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279916/47b0f890093e0064236862cfe338cdcf1732468f.png

Adventurers, Claymores of the Lost Kingdom is now available on Steam for PC!
Have fun and good luck out there! Ruthia is a dangerous place.
